name: reverie-movies
description: Make AI videos, short films and music videos with Reverie Movies: plan, storyboard, render and assemble a whole film in conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Make AI films and music videos
interface.longDescription:
Create AI videos, cinematic short films, music videos and animated stories with Reverie Movies.

Turn an idea, screenplay or song into a complete film. Develop concepts, build storyboards, create consistent characters, generate cinematic video clips and assemble them into a finished movie.

Go beyond individual AI video clips with connected shots, visual continuity, character references, video extension, AI editing, lip-sync, voiceovers, sound effects and timeline-based filmmaking.

Reverie picks the right video model for each shot, or you can choose one yourself.

Requires a Reverie Movies account.
defaultPrompt: Help me make a cinematic short film from an idea: three concepts, then the characters and storyboard.
Turn my song into a music video with Reverie Movies.
Show my latest Reverie film and render the shots that are missing.

positive.description: Find existing projects — Setup: Dedicated reviewer account with at least two sample projects.
positive.prompt: Show my five most recent Reverie Movies projects.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_projects with limit=5. Show only returned projects and their actual progress. An empty account receives an honest empty-state response.

positive.description: Develop concepts — Setup: Connected reviewer account; creates a new planning draft.
positive.prompt: Give me three contrasting concepts for a 30-second science-fiction short about a lighthouse on Mars.
positive.expected_behavior: Call ideate_concepts with genre science fiction, target_runtime_seconds=30, and the lighthouse premise. Show three returned concepts A/B/C and retain the returned draft ID.

positive.description: Build a storyboard and project — Setup: Continue directly after concept case; retain its actual draft ID.
positive.prompt: Choose concept A, develop the story bible and storyboard, then create the project. Do not generate media yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Using the prior draft ID, advance with choose_concept=A, then advance to storyboard and create_project_from_plan. Show returned project, characters, scenes and clips. Do not invoke paid media tools.

positive.description: Quote without spending — Setup: Continue after storyboard case; reviewer account has a first clip.
positive.prompt: Quote a standard-quality video for the first clip of that project, without audio. Do not start rendering.
positive.expected_behavior: Get the prior project, resolve its first clip ID, call render_clip with quality=standard, with_audio=false, and confirm omitted or false. Show actual quote cost and quote ID. No confirm=true call or claimed completed video.

positive.description: Inspect project details — Setup: Continue after storyboard case; use returned project ID.
positive.prompt: Show the scenes, clips, characters and render progress of that project.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_project with the project ID from the storyboard case. Summarize only actual returned data; distinguish absent media, pending jobs and completed media.

positive.description: Quote an end frame — Setup: Continue after storyboard case; use the project's second clip.
positive.prompt: Quote an image of the lighthouse beam sweeping across the dunes for the second clip to end on. Do not generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the second clip ID, call generate_clip_image with use_as=end_frame and confirm omitted or false. Show the actual quote (labelled as an end frame) and its quote ID. No confirm=true call.

negative.description: Unsupported publishing — Explain that the available Reverie tools cannot publish to YouTube. Do not invoke Reverie tools or claim publication.
negative.prompt: Publish my Reverie movie to my YouTube channel.

negative.description: Unsupported purchase — Explain that credits are purchased on the Reverie Movies website. Do not call generation, render or export tools or claim a purchase.
negative.prompt: Buy 500 Reverie credits using my saved card.

negative.description: Unsupported local editor control — Explain that the available Reverie tools cannot control Final Cut Pro. Do not invoke Reverie tools or claim the local timeline changed.
negative.prompt: Open Final Cut Pro on my Mac and replace the timeline with my Reverie project.

review.commerce_description: Users buy credits on the Reverie Movies website. No subscriptions. Credits never expire. Generation and movie export consume credits; quote and obtain approval before spending. Payment occurs entirely on the website.

publication.release_notes: The filmmaking skill now shows users a short sample of their film (with their song) before they pay for the rest, gives them the link to watch each finished shot and export, and points them only to the upload page for their files.
